column2: The "Phoenix VPN" button next to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth: turns the VPN on and off, a long press opens the app. The first time, open the app to grant the VPN permission.

When a server stops working and the app looks for another, it checks which app is open now (usage access needed) and tries servers where that app has already worked first. If the app has its own target, that target's servers go first.

Many servers do not pass UDP: apps wait for a reply and do not open even though Telegram works. With QUIC blocked they switch to plain TCP at once. Recommended to keep on. Applied at the next connection.
Item names depend on the firmware version. If the button did not find the right screen, the app settings will open; continue with the steps above.
Found automatically ({}): apps with Russian packages that are not in the preset. If an app needs the VPN, remove it.
Does not look like a site address

Not tied to the clock: the period counts from the last successful collection. If the phone was off or had no network, collection runs as soon as possible and the next period counts from it. A shorter interval means fresher configs but more traffic and battery use.
Could not restore (the entry is out of date)
Could not save the log (no entries for the chosen period?)
No more than once per 5 minutes and 4 times per hour, so that on a bad network the app does not jump from server to server everywhere.
Nothing to check: no configs or no service selected
A link like https://… is needed
Phone shells (EMUI, MIUI, ColorOS and others) unload background apps on their own. Here is what to allow on your phone.
Common values apply in every mode that has no settings of its own. A mode can have its own: then it follows them and the common ones do not touch it.
The open service does not work on this server
No differences from the common settings.
Estimate of the cost of checks (traffic is approximate). If the numbers are large, turn on "Focus" or quiet hours.
While an app from your targets is open (a game, a bank, a call), the app does not run heavy checks and does not switch servers because of speed. Usage access is needed.
Full protection (even when the app is closed or killed by the system) is turned on only in Android settings: VPN → Phoenix → "Always-on VPN" and "Block connections without VPN".
After a recheck and in the background: working configs that have not yet been checked for the selected services get checked. If you add a service, the already checked ones are checked too.
Pull the shade down → pencil icon (edit) → drag "Phoenix VPN" to the active tiles.
When turned on, the current common values are copied here; after that they can be changed independently.
When the phone starts and when the app opens (last or best config). The system VPN permission is needed once.

The app remembers which hours of the week you use the phone (on the phone only, the file is included in the backup). After a week, in "quiet" hours heavy work does not start without charging, and before the usual start of activity the tunnel is checked in advance.
The app checks which sites open directly and switches the mode when two detections in a row agree. The check runs when the network changes.
The app changes the source blocklist and their priorities by itself. Any such change can be undone within a day.
Rechecks all configs of the mode (first TCP, then real latency through the core). Runs in the background for up to 25 minutes, you can close the screen.
Mode "{}": when it is active, its settings are used (if its own are on), otherwise the common ones.
Russian sites ({} domains: .ru, .рф, Gosuslugi, banks, Yandex, VK…) open directly by default. You can add your own here. Applied at the next connection.
Sites of these apps go directly too
Common settings apply to this mode now. Turn on "Own settings" to change them separately.
